title: Microwell-based Single-Cell RNA-seq
author: Peter Sims
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yqmfvu6
materials: Load buffers and fluorinated oil to reagent reservoirs reagent reservoir 1: 1 mL, lysis buffer reagent reservoir 4: 1.8 mL, fluorinated oil reagent reservoir 5: 2 mL, RNase inhibitor-doped wash buffer
Reverse transcription Prepare the following reverse transcription mixture
Exo-I reaction Prepare the following Exo-I reaction mixture

steps.title: Live Stain Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest and resuspend 500,000 cells in 1 mL TBS (500 cells/uL). Incubate cells in 4 uM CalceinAM (4ul 1mM CalceinAM per ml cells) for 15 minutes on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the following buffers while cells are being stained:

substeps.instruction: Make 1 mL lysis buffer (990 µL buffer TCL + 10 µL 2-Mercaptoethanol).
Make 2 mL RNase inhibitor-doped wash buffer (1998 µL wash buffer + 2 µL SUPERaseIN).

steps.title: Prepare mRNA-Capture Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the capture beads and keep them on ice before use.

substeps.instruction: Gently vortex the beads and transfer 500 µL into a microcentrifuge tube.
Wash the beads with 1 mL TBS buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 400 µL TBS buffer.

steps.title: Load Cells and Beads into Device
steps.instruction: Load the device sequentially with cells and beads, verifying occupancy via microscope.

substeps.instruction: Flush 1 mL TBS through the wash buffer-filled device, avoiding air bubbles.
Load 500 µL live-stained cells; fine-tune liquid puddles at inlet and outlet until cells stop moving. Let cells settle for 3 minutes.
Flush 1 mL TBS gently through the device to avoid washing out cells.
Confirm 5-10% of wells contain a single cell under the microscope.
Load 400 µL TBS-washed beads gently; repeat loading until >60% of wells contain beads.
Flush 1 mL TBS gently through the device.
Confirm >60% of wells contain mRNA-capture-beads under the microscope.

steps.title: Perform Pre-run Fluidics Wash
steps.instruction: Execute the following commands in the MinGW terminal to open channels:

substeps.instruction: Open channel 1 for 10 seconds: "Valvesonly_3_dual_3.exe 10000 1".
Open channel 4 for 10 seconds: "Valvesonly_3_dual_3.exe 10000 4".
Open channel 5 for 30 seconds: "Valvesonly_3_dual_3.exe 30000 5".

steps.title: Run Cell Lysis and mRNA Capture
steps.instruction: Connect the device to the fluidics system and initiate the capture run.

substeps.instruction: Plug inflow (red) and outflow (green) tubing to the device; do not insert tubing all the way to the bottom to avoid clogging.
Execute the command: "SingleCellRNACapture_TCL_dual_large_array_3". Lysis buffer will be pushed through, followed by fluorinated oil to seal the wells.
The device will be heated to 50 °C for lysis and capture, then cooled to room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Cell Lysis QC
steps.instruction: Verify lysis success before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Disconnect device from fluidics and seal inlet/outlet with disc tapes.
Image the device with a 10X fluorescence microscope. Confirm fluorescent dye fills wells that had cells and is absent in empty wells.
If QC passes, unseal inlet/outlet and reconnect to the fluidics system.

steps.title: Load Reverse Transcription Mixture
steps.instruction: Load 500 µL reverse transcription mixture into reagent reservoir 2 before the mRNA capture step is completed.

steps.title: Extract cDNA-Coated Beads
steps.instruction: Recover beads from the device using a syringe-tubing set (2.5 cm green PEEK tubing, 1ml syringe, 12 cm tygon tubing).

substeps.instruction: Prepare 3 mL wash buffer and keep on ice.
Massage the device to dislodge beads and flow 1 mL wash buffer through, collecting the overflow.
Repeat until >95% of beads are removed.

steps.title: Wash and Store cDNA Beads
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes on the extracted beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads with 1 mL TE/SDS buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5% SDS).
Resuspend beads in 1 mL TE/TW buffer.
Store beads at 4 °C.
Wash beads twice (2x) with 1 mL TE/TW buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA, 0.01% Tween-20).

steps.title: Wash Fluidics and Treat Beads with Exo-I
steps.instruction: Clean the system and perform Exo-I treatment on the beads.

substeps.instruction: Rinse and fill all reagent reservoirs (except reservoir 4) with DI water.
Execute command: "SingleCellRNACapture_wash_dual_3.exe".
Wash cDNA-beads twice (2x) with 1 mL nuclease-free water.
Resuspend beads in 50 µL Exo-I reaction mixture and run the program on a thermocycler.

steps.title: Post-Exo-I Bead Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the ExoI-treated beads in the following sequence:

substeps.instruction: 1 mL TE/SDS buffer
1 mL TE/TW buffer (1/2)
1 mL nuclease-free water (1/2)
1 mL TE/TW buffer (2/2)
1 mL nuclease-free water (2/2)

steps.title: SMRT PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using SMRT PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare SMRT PCR reaction mixture.
Resuspend cDNA-beads in 1000 µL SMRT PCR reaction mixture and aliquot 50 µL per PCR tube.
Run the PCR program on a thermocycler.

steps.title: Purify SMRT PCR Product
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified cDNA using 0.6X Ampure beads.

substeps.instruction: Combine all SMRT PCR products into one tube. Spin for 1 minute and transfer 900 µL supernatant to a new tube.
Add 540 µL Ampure beads (0.6X). Incubate at room temperature for 8 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash twice with 1 mL freshly-made 80% ethanol in nuclease-free water (wait 30 seconds between each).
Quick spin for 30 seconds, place on magnetic stand for 30 seconds, and remove residual ethanol.
Air dry beads on magnetic stand for 5 minutes under a KimWipe.
Elute cDNA by adding 20 µL nuclease-free water, mixing by pipetting, incubating for 5 minutes at room temperature, and placing on a magnetic stand for 3 minutes. Keep supernatant.
Store cDNA at -20 °C.

steps.title: cDNA Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform cDNA QC using Qubit and Bioanalyzer following vendor instructions.

steps.title: Nextera Tagmentation Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform tagmentation using the Nextera XT kit.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL TD Buffer to a PCR tube.
Add 5 µL of 0.6 ng cDNA plus nuclease-free water.
Add 5 µL ATM and mix by pipetting.
Run the thermocycler program.
Immediately when temperature reaches 10 ºC, add 5 µL NT Buffer and mix by pipetting.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Selective 3' End Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the 3' end fragment of the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add required reagents (from Nextera XT kit) to the product from the tagmentation step and mix by pipetting.
Run the program on a thermocycler.

steps.title: Purify Nextera Library
steps.instruction: Purify the library using a two-step Ampure bead process.

substeps.instruction: Quick spin PCR product for 1 minute and transfer 50 µL to a new tube.
Add 30 µL Ampure beads (0.6X). Incubate at room temperature for 8 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash twice with 200 µL freshly-made 80% ethanol in nuclease-free water (wait 30 seconds between each).
Quick spin for 30 seconds, place on magnetic stand for 30 seconds, and remove residual ethanol.
Air dry beads on magnetic stand for 5 minutes under a KimWipe.
Elute by adding 50 µL nuclease-free water, mixing by pipetting, incubating for 5 minutes at room temperature, and placing on a magnetic stand for 3 minutes. Keep supernatant.
Repeat the purification process (0.6X steps) using 1X volume Ampure beads (50 µL) and elute with 20 µL nuclease-free water.
Store the Nextera library at -20 °C.

steps.title: Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform Nextera library QC using Qubit and Bioanalyzer following vendor instructions.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the library using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Use custom read 1 sequencing primer.
Use 20% phix.
21 cycles on read 1.
63 cycles on read 2.
8 cycles on index read 1 (if multiple samples are pooled).
